correctness.rationale: Over C with alpha=id and the sole bracket [e2,e2]=e1, D(e1)=a e1+c e2 and D(e2)=b e1+d e2 obey c=0 and a=2d. No other basis pair adds a constraint. Thus Der consists exactly of [[2d,b],[0,d]]. Independently multiplying H=diag(2,1) and E=E12 gives HE-EH=E, and [Der,Der]=C E=[Der,C E], so the lower central series is never zero. The source defines characteristic nilpotence by nilpotence of Der_{alpha^0}, equal here to ordinary derivations. Its CN=Yes table cell must be CN=No; the displayed derivation family is itself correct. The argument covers only this complex alpha=id row.
